What each tool does
Search — one box across 16,953 diagnoses and 1,548 drugs; lay terms like “htn” or “sugar” work. Click any code to copy.
Drug Formulary — SFDA drugs with verified indications and their ICD-10 codes.
ICD-10 Diagnosis — full diagnosis search with validity, sex/age and PDx acceptance badges.
Note → Codes — paste or dictate a note; codes appear live with confidence and CDI prompts.
History Builder — guided clerking with red flags, examination, chronic-disease CHI documentation and claim readiness.
Structured — pulls problems, medications, vitals and labs out of free text.
Calculators — NEWS2, qSOFA, CURB-65 auto-computed from the note; CHA₂DS₂-VASc and Wells interactive.
Justify — CHI-aligned step-therapy prerequisites that reduce pre-authorisation rejections.
Insights — adoption, coverage, quality and rising-complaint signals.
Learning review — IT approves what doctors teach the tool before it reflects for everyone.
All outputs are documentation aids for a clinician to verify — not diagnostic or coverage decisions.

Coder review queue
